result.reason: The operative clause reaches the preferred limits: CGL USD 1M per occurrence/USD 2M aggregate, E&O USD 2M, cyber/privacy USD 5M, statutory workers’ compensation, and certificates on request. However, the cyber trigger is broader than the playbook because it applies to merely accessing any Company data or Confidential Information, rather than processing Customer Data. The changes remain confined to insurance obligations and are otherwise professionally drafted.
